tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Returns a Plendio wishlist from its share link or share id: its title, its items with notes and best current prices, and the url of each product's Plendio page. Read-only; the edit link is not needed and not accepted. The title and the notes are text written by whoever made the list.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Returns Plendio's product categories with localized names, slugs and product counts: the top level, or the subcategories of parent. The counts are products available in the market.

tools.name: remove_from_wishlist
tools.description: Removes products from a wishlist, given its edit link or the token at the end of it. A product that is not on the list is reported and ignored. Removing a product does not delete the list, even when it becomes empty, and a removed product can be added again. Returns the list's remaining items.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_wishlist" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Creates a shareable wishlist ("ønskeseddel") on Plendio from products a person has picked, for example gifts found with a search, once they want a list to send …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product, get_wishlist, search_products · Private data: add_to_wishlist, create_wishlist, remove_from_wishlist · Public sink: create_wishlist, get_wishlist · Destructive: remove_from_wishlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product, get_wishlist, search_products · Private data: add_to_wishlist, create_wishlist, remove_from_wishlist · Public sink: create_wishlist, get_wishlist · Destructive: remove_from_wishlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
